motion_samples_inspected.source: Original 1920x1080 PNG frames from the motion render, bound by motion-manifest.json; raw sequence is in ignored build/motion-frames.

browser_playback.environment: Codex in-app browser, local HTTP preview
browser_playback.scope: Complete playback receipt, not continuous human observation of every frame. Browser total-frame delta differs from callback count; ffprobe independently verifies 192 encoded frames. Local preview seek returned to zero, so visual motion samples were inspected from source PNGs instead.

findings: No missing textures, exposed guide imagery, doubled painted structures or obvious projected-detail mismatch in inspected views.
Cream/oxide/metal weathering is consistent across flanks, top, bow and engines; physical starboard crater backing and torn rims remain readable.
Stored surface coordinates and original geometry remain invariant under the independent transform checks recorded in asset-validation.json.

Stern and underside have more regular, flatter painted cells than the physical armor above; coarse turret housings, fixtures and raised armor rims remain visible. Deep modeled craters remain concentrated on starboard.
disposition: Reusable first all-face Blender material master. No blocking mapping issue observed in sampled views. Further art direction may refine broad shell surfaces and close-up geometry. No final cinematic style acceptance, exhaustive frame review or updated space-shot claim.
